quote: STIVARGA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC)
note: Metastatic colorectal cancer is named directly as a treatment target in both FDA and EMA text; the edge is an exact synonym.

quote: itching of the nose or throat nasal congestion reduces swelling of nasal passages temporarily relieves sinus congestion and pressure
note: OTC label text lists nasal congestion as a symptom the product relieves; the supplied text does not identify these fragments as combination products, so judged on the text as given.

quote: systemic mastocytosis with an associated haematological neoplasm (SM-AHN)
note: EMA indication names SM-AHN, the standard synonym for systemic mastocytosis with an associated clonal hematologic non-mast cell lineage disease.

quote: ILUMYA is an interleukin-23 antagonist indicated for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.
note: Chronic small plaque psoriasis is a more specific form of plaque psoriasis, which is the indicated condition, so the narrower edge is TARGET.

quote: indicated for the treatment of CMV retinitis in patients with acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS)
note: AIDS appears only as the patient population; the thing treated is CMV retinitis.

quote: ELIQUIS is indicated for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE) and reduction in the risk of recurrent VTE in pediatric patients
note: VTE is named as a treatment target (pediatric VTE; adult DVT/PE are VTE subtypes) in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: in the brains of adult patients with cognitive impairment who are being evaluated for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and other causes of cognitive impairment
note: Diagnostic imaging agent; Alzheimer disease is the condition being evaluated, not something the drug treats, prevents or manages.

quote: LUMAKRAS, in combination with panitumumab, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with KRAS G12C -mutated metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC)
note: KRAS G12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer is a subtype of colorectal carcinoma; the edge is a near parent that still describes what is indicated.

quote: or greater than or equal to 27 kg/m 2 in the presence of other risk factors (e.g., controlled hypertension, diabetes, hyperlipidemia)
note: Diabetes is listed only as a comorbid risk factor defining the eligible obese population; the indication is exogenous obesity, and diabetes otherwise appears only in warnings.

quote: indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with recurrent, not amenable to surgery or radiotherapy, or metastatic nasopharyngeal carcinoma
note: EMA text names nasopharyngeal carcinoma directly as a treatment target.

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Dermatomyositis is named explicitly as a treatment indication.

quote: Infections caused by Clostridium species.
note: The indication list names infections caused by Clostridium species, an exact match for Clostridium infectious disease.

quote: For control of severe nausea and vomiting.
note: Nausea and vomiting is the condition controlled; severe nausea and vomiting is a narrower form of the edge.

quote: other CD30-expressing peripheral T-cell lymphomas (PTCL), including angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma and PTCL not otherwise specified (NOS)
note: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma is a named item in the list of indicated PTCL subtypes (combination therapy still counts).

quote: Cabometyx is indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in adults who have previously been treated with sorafenib.
note: EMA text names hepatocellular carcinoma directly as a treatment target.

quote: is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with BRAF V600 mutation-positive unresectable or metastatic melanoma
note: BRAF V600-mutant unresectable/metastatic melanoma is a subtype of melanoma; the edge is a near parent that still describes the indication.

quote: Diphtheria: Infections due to Corynebacterium diphtheriae , as an adjunct to antitoxin, to prevent establishment of carriers and to eradicate the organism in carriers.
note: Diphtheria is a named indication (adjunctive to antitoxin and carrier eradication); adjunctive indications count as TARGET.

quote: Short term treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD).
note: GERD is named directly as a treatment target on multiple famotidine labels.

quote: Moderately severe pneumonia and otitis media due to susceptible Streptococcus pneumoniae .
note: Otitis media is named as an indicated infection; the Bicillin C-R product combines two salts of penicillin G, so the indication is attributable to benzylpenicillin itself.

quote: As an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
note: Type 2 diabetes mellitus is the disease whose glycemic control is managed; named directly in FDA and EMA text.

quote: Reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in chronic open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension
note: Lowering intraocular pressure is the management of open-angle glaucoma itself (as with pain of osteoarthritis), so the disease is the target rather than mere setting.

quote: Reblozyl is indicated in adults for the treatment of transfusion-dependent anaemia due to very low, low and intermediate-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS).
note: The drug treats MDS-associated anemia (section titled 'Myelodysplastic Syndromes Associated Anemia'; EMA 'anaemia due to ... MDS'), the defining manifestation of low-risk MDS, which counts as management of the disease.

quote: Treatment of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and in men at increased risk of fracture
note: EMA text names osteoporosis directly as a treatment target.

quote: PULMICORT RESPULES is indicated for the maintenance treatment of asthma and as prophylactic therapy in children 12 months to 8 years of age.
note: Single-ingredient budesonide labels name asthma as the treated condition, independent of the budesonide/formoterol combination labels.

quote: To reduce TG and the risk of acute pancreatitis in adults with severe hypertriglyceridemia
note: Acute pancreatitis is the event whose risk the drug reduces, i.e. a prevention target (the population is severe hypertriglyceridemia).

quote: Control of severe or incapacitating allergic conditions intractable to adequate trials of conventional treatment in asthma, atopic dermatitis, contact dermatitis
note: Atopic dermatitis (synonym of atopic eczema) is a named item in the list of allergic conditions the drug controls.
The supplied text covers only antibacterial hand soap ('decrease bacteria on the skin'); dental caries or any dental condition is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: Ocular steroids are indicated in inflammatory conditions of the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva, cornea and anterior segment of the globe such as allergic conjunctivitis, acne rosacea
note: Cyclitis appears only on a steroid/tobramycin combination label and is attributed to the steroid component ('Ocular steroids are indicated...'); tobramycin's role is the anti-infective cover, not treatment of cyclitis.

quote: SYMPROIC is indicated for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation (OIC) in adult patients with chronic non-cancer pain
note: Opioid-induced constipation is named directly as the treatment target in FDA and EMA text.
The supplied EMA biosimilar text lists breast, non-small cell lung, renal cell, and ovarian/fallopian/peritoneal cancers only; colorectal cancer is not mentioned anywhere in the supplied text.

quote: Adjunctive treatment of focal-onset seizures with or without secondary generalisation in adult patients with epilepsy
note: Treating focal-onset seizures in patients with epilepsy is treatment of (focal) epilepsy, a subtype of the edge disease; adjunctive use counts.

quote: temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to the common cold, hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies
note: OTC label text names nasal congestion as a symptom the product relieves; the supplied text does not identify these fragments as combination products, so judged on the text as given.

quote: For relief of the signs and symptoms of juvenile rheumatoid arthritis
note: Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis is the standard older synonym for juvenile idiopathic arthritis; relief of its signs and symptoms is management of the disease.

quote: indicated for the complete or partial reversal of opioid drug effects, including respiratory depression, induced by either natural or synthetic opioids
note: Opioid-induced respiratory depression (a form of hypoventilation) is explicitly what the injection reverses, and the nasal sprays treat overdose manifested by respiratory depression.

quote: indicated for the relief of symptoms of depression. Endogenous depressions are more likely to be alleviated than are other depressive states.
note: Depression is the indicated condition and endogenous depression is explicitly named as the subtype most likely to respond.

quote: Tobramycin for Injection is indicated for the treatment of intra-abdominal infections, including peritonitis, caused by susceptible isolates of E. coli
note: Peritonitis is named explicitly as an indicated infection on single-ingredient tobramycin injection labels.

quote: indicated for the reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: Ocular hypertension is elevated intraocular pressure, which is exactly what the drug reduces, so it is the treatment target rather than mere setting.
